items.item_text: Supports faculty search committees: Oversees the academic recruitment process and assists search committees with search plans, posts recruitments to AP Recruit, obtains funding approvals, and places internal and external advertisements. Works with the Central Academic Personnel office to ensure posting adheres to UC Policies. Coordinates campus visits through a selection of final candidates. Collect data and information from multiple sources and prepare complex reports as needed. Participates in the development and revision of standard operating procedures and guidelines. Oversee the undergraduate hiring process for the school of engineering, including all academic departments. Will collaborate with payroll and student employment services to post recruitments for student appointments, submit paperwork for hiring, separation of appointments, reclassifications, and fund changes. Coordinates funding requests with contracts and grants, SoEFinancials, and other fund managers. Works with the Office of Financial Aid and Scholarships toobtain allowed federal work-study appointments and tracks FWS balance and appointments.

Working under the direction of the School Financial team, query and run monthly general ledger financial reports and distribute personnel expenditure reports for the school department accounts, including but not limited to faculty/staff personnel, instructional, capstone, and grad group funds. Provide preliminary reconciliation of personnel and non-personnel expenditures, and ensure electronic financial backup documents are maintained and archived in the reconciliation box folder. Responsible for monthly review and analysis of general and instructional accounts, ensuring balanced ledgers, review of cost allowability, preparation of both payroll (direct retros) and non-payroll cost transfers (n-pct), assisting with transfer of funds, interlocation transfer of funds, and journal entries in cooperation with the SoE financial team. Complete Smart View ad-hoc department monthly financial reports, projections/forecasts, cost transfers, direct retro/payroll transfers, budget requests, interlocation transfer of funds, reconciliation, closeout, and fiscal close for department funds.

Oversight of event coordination for all departments within the school, not limited to event planning and logistics for conference room and equipment reservations, scheduling of on- and off-campus facilities, catering, and distinguished guests' travel arrangements while interacting with other campus units such as Marketing and Conference Services (Auxiliaries-Housing unit), Campus Communications, Risk Management, CBS2, Central Travel, and SoE Financials. Working directly with Procurement and Central Travel and adhering to UC Travel and entertainment policies, expedites and streamlines coordination and processing of travel and entertainment reimbursements for department chairs, distinguished speakers, and guests.

Works closely with the front desk administrative assistant and school on programs, events, and activities, coordinating administrative services. Room scheduling, set-up, travel arrangements, reimbursements, parking, catering, and other special needs. Manages and maintains files and records for the operational services unit. Will assist the unit with departmental meeting support, scheduling, agendas, and meeting minutes. Performs financial duties as assigned, including but not limited to departmental purchasing, reconciliation, change orders, invoicing, and ProCard processing. Data entry is in ServiceNow for purchasing requests and invoices. Lock & Access Coordination: Determines lock and access for all constituents in the School - faculty, students, and staff. Coordinate CatCard access for the School overall and for department chairs as directed. Ensure that those who need access have completed the proper training. Will oversee the key issuance process.
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Business Management, or a related area or equivalent experience/education/training.
